Criterion: Verify that exterior lights utilized during the aerial refueling process are compatible with NVIS or automated systems. Standard: Exterior lights utilized during the aerial refueling process are compatible with NVIS or automated systems (see also 9.3.4, this document). Method of Compliance: Verification methods include analysis, test, demonstration, and review of documentation. Analysis, ground and flight test/demonstration verify compatibility of all appropriate lights with NVIS and/or automated systems. References: JSSG-2010: 3.5.3.3, 4.5.3.3 ATP-3.3.4.2 NATO STANAG 3971 MIL-HDBK-516: 9 14 CFR 23.951-23.1001, 25.951-25.1001
